title: Not All Correct Fixes Run Alike: An Empirical Study of Patch Performance in Repository-Level Issue Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.13563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks such as SWE-bench evaluate submitted patches primarily based on whether they pass the correctness tests, leaving the runtime performance of different test-passing patches largely unexplored. Evaluating patch performance is essential but challenging since designing performance workloads for each benchmark instance is costly. However, these benchmarks already provide a natural candidate: the built-in \emph{FAIL\_TO\_PASS} (F2P) tests, which exercise the behavior affected by the issue fix. We therefore investigate whether the provided F2P tests can be repurposed to evaluate patch performance. translated_title: 并非所有正确的修复运行时表现都相同：仓库级问题解决中补丁性能的实证研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：诸如 SWE-bench 等仓库级问题解决基准主要依据提交的补丁是否通过正确性测试来进行评估，而对于不同通过测试的补丁的运行时性能，在很大程度上尚未被探索。评估补丁性能至关重要但充满挑战，因为为每个基准实例设计性能测试工作负载的成本很高。然而，这些基准本身已经提供了一个天然的候选方案：内置的 FAIL_TO_PASS（F2P）测试，它会触发受问题修复影响的行为。因此，我们研究了所提供的 F2P 测试能否被重新用于评估补丁性能。总体而言，我们选择了四个前沿模型——Claude Opus 5、GPT 5.6、DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Qwen 3.8 Max——并与 SWE-agent 配对，解决从 SWE-bench 和 SWE-bench-Live 已验证分割中预先筛选出的可测量语料库，最终得到 262 个至少包含两种不同正确解决方案的案例，其中包括开发（测试）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将基准自带的 FAIL_TO_PASS 测试重新用于评估补丁的运行时性能，发现通过正确性测试的不同补丁在运行性能上存在显著差异，即并非所有正确的修复运行起来都一样。
en_tdlr: This study repurposes the built-in FAIL_TO_PASS tests to evaluate the runtime performance of test-passing patches in repository-level issue resolution, revealing that not all correct fixes run alike.
